objects.rationale: Cover the radio material, typography, camera focus, all studio lights and finished image in both workspace modes. Reserve optical and sampling detail for disclosure panels; raw object transforms remain in the selected-object inspector and full catalog. Pair the perspective lens with real camera distance and subject-size compensation.

easy.label: Movement
easy.help: Change how strongly the objects perform.

easy.label: Lighting
easy.help: Balance the main light, shadow fill and highlights.

easy.label: Product finish
easy.help: Choose a smoother or more matte surface.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

procedural.rationale: Expose every planned 2D control: typography, palette, shape density/scale, line and particle detail, pace, wave/beat performance, overlays and finishing. Easy and Pro retain the same creative capabilities, with target curves providing the precision layer.

easy.label: Movement
easy.help: Coordinate the rhythm, waves and beat response.

easy.label: Graphic detail
easy.help: Use fewer large shapes or a denser composition.

easy.label: Text size
easy.help: Adjust the headline size without editing the layout.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

pop.rationale: Expose all planned 2D and lettering controls: title/caption sizing, halftone/burst/window motifs, palette, scene and ticker motion, camera/lens and texture. Preserve the authored default collage and give both workspace modes the same creative coverage. Pair the perspective lens with real camera distance and subject-size compensation.

easy.label: Movement
easy.help: Coordinate camera movement and graphic rhythm.

easy.label: Text size
easy.help: Resize headlines and captions together.

easy.label: Graphic impact
easy.help: Change the bursts and printed texture together.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

starter.rationale: Include all implemented product materials, lens, key/fill lighting and grade controls. Camera and product animation are edited in Motion; avoid unsupported material or renderer settings. Pair the perspective lens with real camera distance and subject-size compensation.

easy.label: Lighting
easy.help: Balance the main light and shadow fill on the product.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

pulse.rationale: Cover separate speaker/record performance, framing and macro focus, key/fill/rim lighting, real surface roughness, display/background brightness and finishing in both modes. Keep aggregate mechanism gain and light shape in secondary panels; preserve authored camera cuts and neutral material defaults. Pair the perspective lens with real camera distance and subject-size compensation.

easy.label: Movement
easy.help: Coordinate the mechanism, speaker and record.

easy.label: Lighting
easy.help: Balance the product highlights and shadows.

easy.label: Background softness
easy.help: Make the background clearer or softer behind the product.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

camera.rationale: Include every implemented city-motion, lens, focus, lighting and image control. Bloom and grain are normal finishing tools in both modes, while authored camera cuts remain intact. Pair the perspective lens with real camera distance and subject-size compensation.

easy.label: City movement
easy.help: Adjust the movement of the miniature city.

easy.label: Lighting
easy.help: Balance the scene light and shadows.

easy.label: Background softness
easy.help: Choose how much the background falls out of focus.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

panels.title: Character camera
panels.help: Camera movement affects the graphic composition. Wide lens and Camera distance affect the physical device after 12 seconds.

dot.rationale: Expose character acting, graphic framing and finish in both modes. Pair the physical device lens with actual distance and subject-size compensation; these controls affect its 3D reveal after 12 seconds. The earlier 2D character layouts remain unchanged.

easy.label: Personality
easy.help: Coordinate character acting and camera movement.

easy.label: Character size
easy.help: Make the character smaller or larger in the existing framing.

easy.label: Glow
easy.help: Choose how strongly the character glows.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

replay.rationale: Expose every planned editorial control: card spacing/tilt/scale/depth, composition scale and poster spacing, reveal pace, orbit scale/speed, final camera push, connecting threads and grade. The same planned controls are available in Easy and Pro; neutral values preserve the editorial film. Pair the perspective lens with real camera distance and subject-size compensation.

easy.label: Movement
easy.help: Coordinate reveals, orbiting cards and the closing push.

easy.label: Card depth
easy.help: Coordinate the card spacing, depth and tilt.

easy.label: Content size
easy.help: Resize the editorial content and cards together.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

loop.rationale: Preserve refinement controls and expose the asset drag duration ahead of the fixed Send/drop timing.

easy.label: Product movement
easy.help: Coordinate turns, separation and close-up movement.

easy.label: Text movement
easy.help: Move the titles more quietly or with more energy, keeping the same story.

easy.label: Lighting
easy.help: Balance the product light and shadows together.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.

appdemo.rationale: Only motion strength, headline size and finishing: content and focus are edited in App Demo. Flat screenshots do not need lens or lighting controls.

easy.label: Screen movement
easy.help: Choose how much the screens move during the walkthrough.

easy.label: Headline size
easy.help: Keep the existing text and change its size.

easy.label: Color mood
easy.help: Adjust color strength and contrast together.
